title: Coconut Marinated Chicken (Grill or Stove)
reject_reason: Chicken cooked in a coconut-milk + curry-powder + lime sauce reads as the same coconut-curry-chicken dinner as live kuku-paka-swahili-coconut-chicken-curry (protein + coconut-curry family + stovetop + no starch); the coconut x chicken region is already saturated (15).
